subject: general
question: Nuts, vegetable oil, and fish are good source of which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Healthy fats**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Monounsaturated **fats and **polyunsaturated **fats are known as the “good fats” because they are good for your heart, your cholesterol, and your overall health.
 
• These fats can help to **lower the risk of heart disease** and stroke, cholesterol levels, and Prevent abnormal heart rhythms.
 
• Monounsaturated fat good sources include olive, canola, peanut, and sesame oils, Nuts (almonds, peanuts, macadamia, hazelnuts, pecans, cashews), avocados etc.
 
• Polyunsaturated fat good sources include Sunflower, sesame, and pumpkin seeds, Walnuts, Fatty fish (salmon, tuna, mackerel, herring, trout, sardines) fish oil, Soybean and safflower oil, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unhealthy fats **

 
 
• Trans fat. Small amounts of naturally occurring trans fats can be found in meat and dairy products but it's artificial trans fats that are considered dangerous. 
 
• This is the worst type of fat since it not only raises bad LDL cholesterol but also lowers good HDL levels.
 
 
 
• **Carbohydrates**
 
 
• They're the body's primary source of energy and the brain's preferred energy source. Carbs are broken down by the body into glucose.
 
 
 
• **Minerals**
 
 
• Minerals are those elements in foods that our bodies need to develop and function normally.
 
• Those essential for health include calcium, phosphorus, potassium, sodium, chloride, magnesium, iron, zinc, iodine, etc.
 
 
 
• **Protein**
 
 
• Protein is considered the building block of life and is found in every cell of the body.
 
• Protein is made up of amino acids that are attached to one another in long chains.
